description: Deaths the potential-lives figure leaves out (unknown belt / helmet use) and the share of unbelted deaths in single-occupant vehicles, where no pair comparison exists
method: Census counts; occupancy = drivers and passengers (A_PTYPE 1/2) recorded in the person's vehicle in FARS person/per_aux, whether or not they were killed
inputs: FARS person (INJ_SEV, PER_TYP, AGE, SEX, LOCATION, STR_VEH)
